news.body:
• SmackDown opens with Sami Zayn, Johnny Gargano, and Candice LeRae. Sami says he has plenty to tell Roman Reigns, The OTC1, and vows to deliver his message face-to-face on next week’s Raw.
• Trick Williams defeats Johnny Gargano.
• Chelsea Green is set to defend the WWE Women’s Championship against Nikki Bella on the October 30 episode of SmackDown.
• Paige defeats Nikki Bella.
• Damian Priest defeats R-Truth by referee stoppage after Truth suffers an injury during the match.
• Gunther vs. Danhausen is officially announced for the October 30 episode of SmackDown.
• Fatal Influence demand another shot at Alexa Bliss and Tatum Paxley’s WWE Women’s Tag Team Championships.
• Jade Cargill, Michin, and B-Fab confront Fatal Influence, making it clear that they want the next opportunity at the Women’s Tag Team Titles.
• Rey Fenix defeats Ricky Saints by disqualification after Saints shoves referee Charles Robinson into the ropes.
• Cody Rhodes defeats Baron Corbin by disqualification

🔴 WWE RAW PREVIEW: ROMAN REIGNS RETURNS ON OCTOBER 19

Wrestling Buzz | WWE News | October 18, 2026

WWE Monday Night RAW is set to deliver another exciting night of wrestling as Roman Reigns prepares to return to the show on October 19, 2026. With Crown Jewel approaching, fans will be watching closely for developments involving the World Heavyweight Champion and other major WWE Superstars.

👑 Roman Reigns Returns to RAW

Roman Reigns is advertised to appear on Monday Night RAW after missing the previous week's episode. His return comes as anticipation builds for his upcoming champion-versus-champion showdown with Undisputed WWE Champion Sami Zayn at Crown Jewel.

Fans will be eager to see whether Reigns addresses his upcoming opponent or becomes involved in other developing rivalries.

⚔️ Joe Hendry vs. JD McDonagh

One of the announced matches for the show will see Joe Hendry face Judgment Day member JD McDonagh.

The two have been involved in an ongoing rivalry, and their encounter gives both Superstars an opportunity to gain momentum. Hendry will look to secure an important victory, while McDonagh will be determined to prove himself inside the ring.

🔥 The Bloodline and The 946 Storyline

The ongoing situation involving The Bloodline and The 946 is another story to watch.

Developments from the previous episode have raised questions about what could happen next. With Roman Reigns returning, fans will be watching to see whether he addresses the situation and what consequences may follow.

⭐ Other Superstars to Watch

Several other WWE Superstars are advertised for the upcoming episode, including:

Oba Femi

Liv Morgan

Dominik Mysterio

Penta

Sol Ruca


Their appearances could bring additional developments, although any matches or segments not officially announced should be treated as unconfirmed.

📅 WWE MONDAY NIGHT RAW: SHOW DETAILS

Date: Monday, October 19, 2026

Location: San Diego, California

Venue: Pechanga Arena

Featured appearance: Roman Reigns
